Overview.Name: Swetha Murala
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: 2 egg omelette (pan fried in ghee)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (80 g) & cucumber slices
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small) & paneer cubes (60 g)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (small portion) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & paneer curry (80 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_4: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & cucumber salad
Option 2: Paneer cubes (60–80 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: For PCOS, keep rice portions controlled and prioritize eggs, chicken or paneer in meals.
Fried cravings often appear due to boredom. Eat protein first before deciding on snacks.
Keep the last meal lighter than lunch to support hormone balance and fat loss.
Consistent meal timing improves insulin sensitivity and helps manage PCOS symptoms.
Expect gradual fat loss around waist and lower belly with consistent meals and movement.
